sentences.spanishText: La semana pasada, tuve una experiencia terrible.
sentences.englishText: Last week, I had a terrible experience.

sentences.spanishText: No fue un accidente de coche.
sentences.englishText: It was not a car accident.

sentences.spanishText: No fue una visita al dentista.
sentences.englishText: It wasn't a visit to the dentist.
It was something much worse.
I tried to print a document.

sentences.spanishText: Sé lo que estás pensando: "¡Qué valiente!
sentences.englishText: I know that you're thinking, "How brave!"
"How did you survive?"
Thank you for your concern.
I'm still recovering.

sentences.spanishText: Todo comenzó el martes por la mañana.
sentences.englishText: It all started Tuesday morning.
I needed to print a single page.

sentences.spanishText: Era una página muy sencilla, con algunas palabras y un pequeño dibujo.
sentences.englishText: It was a very simple page, with a few words and a small drawing.

sentences.spanishText: Pensé que el trabajo iba a durar treinta segundos.
sentences.englishText: I thought the job would last thirty seconds.

sentences.spanishText: Qué hombre tan inocente era yo.
sentences.englishText: What an innocent man I was.
First, I turned on the printer.

sentences.spanishText: Inmediatamente apareció un mensaje en la pantalla:
sentences.englishText: Immediately a message appeared on the screen:
ERROR 47: UNKNOWN PROBLEM.

sentences.spanishText: No sabía qué significaba el error 47.
sentences.englishText: I didn't know what error 47 meant.

sentences.spanishText: Busqué en Internet y descubrí que nadie lo sabía.
sentences.englishText: I searched the Internet and found that no one knew.
Not even the manufacturer.

sentences.spanishText: Según su página web, el error 47 podía significar que la impresora tenía un problema de conexión, que necesitaba tinta o que estaba emocionalmente cansada.
sentences.englishText: According to its website, error 47 could mean that the printer had a connection problem, that it needed ink or that it was emotionally tired.

sentences.spanishText: Decidí apagarla y encenderla otra vez.
sentences.englishText: I decided to turn it off and turn it on again.

sentences.spanishText: Este método es la solución oficial para el 93 por ciento de los problemas tecnológicos.
sentences.englishText: This method is the official solution for 93 percent of technological problems.

sentences.spanishText: El otro siete por ciento requiere comprar un aparato nuevo.
sentences.englishText: The other seven percent require buying a new device.

sentences.spanishText: Después de reiniciar la impresora, apareció otro mensaje:
sentences.englishText: After restarting the printer, another message appeared:
UPDATE AVAILABLE.
I didn't want an update.
I wanted a page.

sentences.spanishText: Pero la impresora no me dio otra opción.
sentences.englishText: But the printer didn't give me another option.

sentences.spanishText: Comenzó a descargar una actualización de 847 megabytes.
sentences.englishText: It started downloading an 847 megabyte update.

sentences.spanishText: No sé por qué una máquina que pone tinta sobre papel necesita 847 megabytes de información.
sentences.englishText: I don’t know why a machine that puts ink on paper needs 847 megabytes of information.

sentences.spanishText: Tal vez estaba descargando todas las novelas de la historia.
sentences.englishText: Maybe I was downloading all the novels in history.

sentences.spanishText: Cuarenta minutos después, la impresora estaba lista.
sentences.englishText: Forty minutes later, the printer was ready.
Or so I thought.

sentences.spanishText: Cuando intenté imprimir, apareció un tercer mensaje:
sentences.englishText: When I tried to print, a third message appeared:
THERE'S NOT ENOUGH YELLOW INK.

sentences.spanishText: Esto me sorprendió porque mi documento era completamente negro.
sentences.englishText: This surprised me because my document was completely black.
I called the technical service.
“Good morning,” I said.

sentences.spanishText: Mi impresora no quiere imprimir porque no tiene tinta amarilla.
sentences.englishText: My printer doesn't want to print because it doesn't have yellow ink.
“I understand,” replied a very kind woman.
Does your document contain the color yellow?
"No."
Then you need to buy yellow ink.
Why?
“Because the printer needs it.”
“For what?”
There was a long silence.
“Sir,” she said finally, “have you tried to restart the printer?”

sentences.spanishText: En ese momento comprendí que la humanidad había cometido un terrible error al inventar las computadoras.
sentences.englishText: At that time I understood that humanity had made a terrible mistake in inventing computers.
But I couldn't give up.

sentences.spanishText: Compré un cartucho de tinta amarilla por 39 dólares.
sentences.englishText: I bought a yellow ink cartridge for 39 dollars.

sentences.spanishText: Por ese precio, esperaba que el cartucho también preparara café y limpiara la cocina.
sentences.englishText: For that price, I was hoping the cartridge would also make coffee and clean the kitchen.
I installed it carefully.

sentences.spanishText: La impresora hizo varios ruidos extraños.
sentences.englishText: The printer made several strange noises.

sentences.spanishText: Primero sonó como un pequeño tractor.
sentences.englishText: First it sounded like a small tractor.

sentences.spanishText: Después hizo un ruido parecido al de una vaca enferma.
sentences.englishText: Then it made a noise similar to that of a sick cow.
Finally, it was silent.
On the screen appeared:
UNRECOGNIZED CARTRIDGE.
I looked at the cartridge.
I looked at the printer.
It's your cartridge!
I shouted.
I bought it in your own store!

sentences.spanishText: Mi esposa entró en la habitación.
sentences.englishText: My wife came into the room.

sentences.spanishText: —¿Por qué estás gritando a la impresora?
sentences.englishText: Why are you screaming at the printer?
Because it's an idiot.
Have you tried to restart it?
Our conversation ended there.

sentences.spanishText: Finalmente, después de tres horas, conseguí imprimir mi página.
sentences.englishText: Finally, after three hours, I got my page to print.
Well, almost.

sentences.spanishText: La impresora produjo una hoja de papel completamente blanca.
sentences.englishText: The printer produced an all-white sheet of paper.

sentences.spanishText: En la pantalla apareció un mensaje final:
sentences.englishText: A final message appeared on the screen:

sentences.spanishText: Me quedé mirando la hoja durante varios segundos.
sentences.englishText: I stared at the sheet for several seconds.

sentences.spanishText: Entonces tomé un bolígrafo y escribí el documento a mano.
sentences.englishText: Then I took a pen and wrote the document by hand.
It took forty-five seconds.

sentences.spanishText: Ahora estoy considerando una nueva carrera como escritor profesional de documentos escritos a mano.
sentences.englishText: Now I’m considering a new career as a professional writer of handwritten documents.

sentences.spanishText: Creo que el futuro de la tecnología está en el bolígrafo.
sentences.englishText: I think the future of technology is in the pen.
No need for updates.
It does not need an internet connection.
It doesn't need yellow ink.

sentences.spanishText: Y, lo más importante, nunca me ha pedido que lo reinicie.
sentences.englishText: And most importantly, it's never asked me to restart it.

sentences.spanishText: Por supuesto, todavía existe un problema.
sentences.englishText: Of course, there is still a problem.
